name: MBA in India right after B.Tech
description: Take CAT and other entrance tests in final year and join a two-year programme straight after graduation.
typical_timing: Entrance tests in 4th year (Nov to Jan); programme starts after graduation

name: MBA in India after work experience
description: Work for some years after B.Tech, then apply; many programmes give weight to work experience.
typical_timing: Entrance tests after 1 to 3+ years of work

name: MBA abroad
description: Apply with GMAT or GRE scores, usually after several years of work experience.
typical_timing: Usually after 2 to 5 years of work

name: Masters in Management abroad
description: Pre-experience management masters for recent graduates, usually with GMAT or GRE.
typical_timing: Final year or soon after graduation
